## Epistemic Honesty & Verification Boundary (Read First)

> **Solo Human + Disclosed AI-Assisted Research Infrastructure:** This atlas is architected, directed, audited, and published by solo researcher **Alexander Stephen Donahue** with disclosed frontier AI assistance (see [`AUTHORS.md`](AUTHORS.md), [`docs/AI_DISCLOSURE.md`](docs/AI_DISCLOSURE.md), and [`docs/DATASHEET.md`](docs/DATASHEET.md)).
> - **What IS machine-verified:** All **72 Pure Lean 4.35.0 theorems** (`lean/MegaAtlasProofs/`, 8 modules, 1,008 lines, zero Mathlib, zero `sorry`, zero `native_decide`, zero `Classical.choice`, axioms strictly within `[propext, Quot.sound]` or empty) certifying exact scoring, quadrant, era, taxonomy, finite graph handshaking, pairwise delta antisymmetry, Karpathy AutoResearch anti-gaming keep/discard gates, and multi-layer substrate/gradient/margin invariants; JSON Schema Draft 2020-12 compliance across all `1,900 × 48` fields; 25-test `pytest` suite (including dual-framed 9-tool MCP stdio JSON-RPC & FAIR SHA-256 parity); biconnected graph topology (`0` articulation points, `0` bridges, `0` dangling links); and byte-exact SHA-256 digests (`CHECKSUMS.sha256`).
> - **What is NOT claimed:** This repository makes **zero claim to solve any open problem** (including Track B's finite Antihydra `BB(6)` probe in `research/runs/LOG-002_antihydra_pilot/`). Quantitative rubric scores (`difficulty`, `tractability_2050`, `impact`, `interdisciplinarity`, `CSS`, `Titan Index`, gradients, spectrum) are **transparent, falsifiable editorial estimates** — not peer-reviewed measurements. Every record carries an explicit `verification_flag`, and **all 12 Fall/Nov 2026 AI proof claims remain officially unretired** pending independent fidelity auditing and peer consensus.

---

## November 20, 2026 AI Proof-Claim Verification Advisory

Active mathematical registries already track well over 1,100–2,000+ open problems (`ProofAtlas.ai`: 1,100+ eligible / 243 open in Top-500; `erdosproblems.com`: ~1,221 tracked / ~630+ open; Kourovka: >1,000; Kirby: >360). Fall–November 2026 saw dramatic AI proof claims—including OpenAI's Sept 8 **3D Navier–Stokes** blowup claim (`ANL-001`), OpenAI's Oct 6 **722-manuscript bulk release** across 372 topics, and the Nov 20 **Levent Alpöge / Claude multi-million-line Lean 4 Riemann Hypothesis & GRH archive** (`NT-001`, `NT-002`) alongside Stanford's **Alessandro Masullo** human draft. Because Lean kernel compilation checks logical deduction *rather than formalization statement fidelity or community consensus*, **all 12 AI-claimed problems are strictly retained as OPEN under `verification_flag = "ai-claim-under-audit-nov2026"`**.

## Quickstart: Offline RAG, 9-Tool MCP Server, AutoResearch & Full Rebuild

```bash
# Install Python dependencies
pip install -r requirements.txt

# 1. Query the zero-API Hybrid BM25 + PageRank RAG CLI (100.0% MRR@5, <30 ms)
python rag/query.py "turbulence climate sensitivity" --top 6 --hops 1
python rag/query.py --compare NT-001 CS-001
python rag/query.py --flag ai-claim-under-audit-nov2026 --top 20

# 2. Launch the 9-tool dual-framed Model Context Protocol (MCP) stdio server
python mcp_server/server.py

# 3. Run the immutable Karpathy-style AutoResearch evaluation oracle & forensic audit
python autoresearch/evaluate.py --verify-gates
python scripts/forensic_audit.py
python scripts/publish_zenodo.py --dry-run

# 4. Verify all 72 Pure Lean 4.35.0 formal invariants & print axioms
cd lean && lake build && cd ..

# 5. Run the full 25-test pytest suite & cryptographic SHA-256 auditor
pytest -v
python scripts/audit_atlas.py --check-lean
```

To rebuild every chart, dataset, SQLite DB, `RANKING.md`, FAIR metadata, HTML, PDF, Lean proof, and SHA-256 checksum from scratch:
- **Windows PowerShell:** `.\build.ps1`
- **Unix / macOS / WSL:** `make all` or `just reproduce`

# AGENTS.md — AI Coding & Research Agent Onboarding Contract

> Standard repository instructions for Claude Code, Antigravity, Cursor, Codex, Gemini CLI, and autonomous research agents working inside **`0thernes/unsolved-problems-mega-atlas` (`v2.3.1`)**.

## 1. Canonical Identity & Attribution (MANDATORY)

- **Author / Human-in-the-Loop:** Alexander Stephen Donahue (`Alexander S. Donahue`)
- **ORCID:** `0009-0006-8168-9648` (`https://orcid.org/0009-0006-8168-9648`)
- **Affiliation:** Independent Researcher, Spokane, WA, USA · `0_0@0thernes.art` · `https://0thernes.art` (never assert an unformed LLC entity)
- **Master Research Archive:** `0TH-BUILD-007` in `https://github.com/0thernes/0thernes-research-archive`
- **Dual License:** Data/Prose/Charts/PDF (`CC BY 4.0`, `LICENSE`) · Code/Schemas/RAG/MCP/Lean (`MIT`, `LICENSE-CODE`).
- **Build Standard v1.2.0 Hard Rules (`R1`–`R8`):** Commit straight to `main`, zero PR templates or banned bot configs (`R4`), report-only linters (`R3`), zero fabricated numbers (`R6`), 10-class finding taxonomy (`R7`).

## 2. Non-Negotiable Epistemic & Verification Rules

1. **Zero Proof Inflation:** Never claim to prove, solve, or retire any of the 1,900 open problems. All 12 Fall/Nov 2026 AI proof-claim targets (`verification_flag = "ai-claim-under-audit-nov2026"`) MUST stay explicitly unretired pending independent formal-statement fidelity and peer consensus. Track B empirical probes (e.g., `research/runs/LOG-002_antihydra_pilot/`) must carry explicit non-claim boundaries.
2. **Pure Lean 4.35.0 Hygiene (`lean/`):** Zero Mathlib, zero `sorry`, zero `admit`, zero `native_decide`, zero custom `axiom` declarations. Every theorem (**72 audited**) must be listed in `lean/MegaAtlasProofs/VerifyAxioms.lean` and depend strictly on `[propext, Quot.sound]` or empty.
3. **Anti-Gaming Harness Lock:** During autonomous optimization loops (`autoresearch/program.md`), **NEVER modify** `autoresearch/evaluate.py`, `schema/*.json`, `tests/test_mega_atlas.py` (never weaken assertions), or `VERIFICATION.md`.
4. **Honest AI Disclosure & Zero Auth/PoW Bypass:** Never fabricate DOIs, peer-review endorsements, or fake external citations; never bypass CAPTCHAs or Software Heritage Anubis PoW gates. Preserve negative/discarded experiment rows in `autoresearch/results.tsv`.
5. **Biconnected Graph Hygiene:** Any edit to `src/v2_data/m01..m11.py` must maintain `unresolved_raw_links_count == 0`, `connected_components == 1`, `articulation_points == 0`, and `graph_bridges == 0` (checked by `scripts/forensic_audit.py`).
6. **ReFS Dev Drive & Windows PowerShell Safety:** When running on Windows in bracketed paths, always use `-LiteralPath`. Keep virtual environments inside `.venv/` (gitignored).

# Claims Ledger (`CLAIMS.md`)

Every structural, formal, algorithmic, and epistemic claim made by **Unsolved Problems Mega-Atlas** is numbered, paired with verifiable evidence, and paired with an explicit falsification criterion (**what would prove us wrong**).

| ID | Claim | Verification Tier | Evidence | What Would Prove Us Wrong |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **C1** | The dataset contains exactly `1,900` unique, strictly deduplicated problems across `8` Macro-Pillars, `28` Superdomains, `8` Substrates, and `7` Abstraction Layers (`48` typed fields), with `0` JSON Schema Draft 2020-12 errors and `0` unresolved `raw_links`. | **Automated schema & exact audit** | `tests/test_mega_atlas.py`, `scripts/audit_atlas.py`, `scripts/forensic_audit.py` | Any duplicate `id`, missing column, JSON Schema violation, or dangling `raw_links` reference. |
| **C2** | The `5,808`-edge undirected connectome has `1` connected component, `0` articulation points, and `0` bridge edges (true 2-vertex-connected biconnected graph), satisfying the Handshaking Lemma $\sum \deg = 2|E|$. | **Exact NetworkX audit + Lean 4 theorem** | `test_graph_biconnectivity_and_handshaking`, `MegaAtlasProofs.GraphInvariants` | Any disconnected vertex, articulation point, bridge edge, or degree-sum discrepancy. |
| **C3** | All `72` formal invariant theorems in `lean/MegaAtlasProofs/` compile in Pure Lean 4.35.0 (zero Mathlib, zero `sorry`, zero `admit`, zero `native_decide`, zero `Classical.choice`, axioms strictly within `[propext, Quot.sound]` or empty). | **Kernel-checked Lean 4.35.0** | `lean/MegaAtlasProofs/VerifyAxioms.lean`, `.github/workflows/ci.yml` | Any forbidden Lean token, missing theorem, or axiom outside `[propext, Quot.sound]`. |
| **C4** | The offline Hybrid BM25 + Title-Bigram + PageRank RAG engine achieves `100.0% MRR@5` (`25/25` top-1) on the immutable 25-query cross-pillar benchmark (`autoresearch/evaluate.py`, `AQS = 97.99`), and the dual-framed 9-tool MCP stdio server passes both NDJSON and `Content-Length` JSON-RPC 2.0 tests. | **Automated deterministic pytest + AutoResearch oracle** | `autoresearch/evaluate.py --verify-gates`, `test_mcp_stdio_server_*` | Any query dropping below top-1, `AQS < 97.0`, or JSON-RPC framing failure. |
| **C5** | Zero of the `1,900` open problems are claimed solved or retired by this repository (including all `12` Fall/Nov 2026 AI proof claims under `verification_flag = "ai-claim-under-audit-nov2026"` and the 2026-11-25 audit of `0thernes-research-archive`). | **Explicit epistemic audit** | `test_nov2026_ai_claims_explicitly_flagged`, `docs/0THERNES_SOLVED_AUDIT_2026-11-25.md` | Any record falsely claiming retirement of an unverified AI claim or unreviewed preprint. |
| **C6** | All frozen artifacts across CSV, TSV, JSON, JSONL, SQLite+FTS5, 14-sheet XLSX, 8-sheet XLS, 30 charts, FAIR metadata (`croissant.json`, `ro-crate-metadata.json`, `.zenodo.json`), and monographs match byte-exact SHA-256 checksums (`CHECKSUMS.sha256` and `data/MANIFEST.sha256`). | **Cryptographic SHA-256 check** | `scripts/audit_atlas.py`, `test_sha256_checksums_manifest_exact`, `test_croissant_json_ld_and_sha256_parity` | Any SHA-256 mismatch or cross-format row/column drift. |

## Explicit Falsification Protocol (What Would Prove Us Wrong)

Any of the following refutes a claim above and will be logged in `CHANGELOG.md` and corrected immediately:
1. A failing record against `schema/problem.schema.json` or an unresolved graph edge in `src/v2_loader.py`.
2. A Lean 4 kernel rejection, forbidden token, or disallowed axiom in `lean/MegaAtlasProofs/`.
3. A SHA-256 mismatch in `CHECKSUMS.sha256`, `data/MANIFEST.sha256`, or `croissant.json`.
4. A demonstrated factual error in a problem's historical status, domain taxonomy, or 2026 AI-claim verification flag (report via `.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/status-update-or-falsification.yml`).

===== FILE: LIMITATIONS.md =====
# Limitations, Epistemic Boundaries & Real-vs-Metaphor (`LIMITATIONS.md`)

## 1. What This Atlas Does and Does Not Claim

- **Zero solved-problem claims:** This repository is a **research taxonomy, knowledge graph, and verification infrastructure** — it makes **zero claim** to solve or retire any of the `1,900` open problems (see also [`docs/0THERNES_SOLVED_AUDIT_2026-11-25.md`](docs/0THERNES_SOLVED_AUDIT_2026-11-25.md)).
- **Editorial vs. formal metrics:** The `72` Pure Lean 4.35.0 theorems (`lean/MegaAtlasProofs/`) verify exact **mathematical properties of the scoring, classification, graph-handshaking, and AutoResearch gate functions** — they do **NOT** prove that the subjective rubric inputs (`difficulty_score`, `tractability_2050`, `civilizational_impact`, `interdisciplinarity_index`) are objective physical constants. Those rubric inputs are transparent, falsifiable editorial estimates.
- **No external peer review:** The catalog, white paper (`docs/WHITE_PAPER.md`), and rubric scores have been authored by solo researcher Alexander Stephen Donahue with disclosed AI assistance (see `docs/AI_DISCLOSURE.md` and `docs/DATASHEET.md`) and have not undergone formal journal peer review.
- **12 Nov 2026 AI proof claims remain unretired:** Lean kernel compilation alone does not establish formalization statement fidelity or community consensus; all 12 AI-targeted problems stay open under `verification_flag = "ai-claim-under-audit-nov2026"`.
- **Committed release artifacts > 5 MB (Build Standard `A24` trade-off):** Six generated dataset/monograph files inside `outputs/` (`MegaAtlas_Comprehensive_Report_V2.pdf`, `MegaAtlas_Interactive_Dashboard_V2.html`, `MegaAtlas_Print_Report_V2.html`, `MegaAtlas_Unsolved_Problems_V2.sqlite`, `.json`, `.jsonl`) exceed 5 MB. They are intentionally committed so GitHub Pages, the offline RAG CLI, the 9-tool MCP server, and `pytest` work directly from a clean clone without external LFS or cloud hosting (see [ADR 0002](docs/adr/0002-dual-license-and-committed-atlas-artifacts.md)).

## 2. Real vs. Metaphor

- **"Connectome" / "Keystone Domino Hubs":** Graph-theoretic metaphors for the literal undirected co-dependency graph $G = (V, E)$ with $|V|=1{,}900$ problem nodes and $|E|=5{,}808$ curated mathematical/scientific dependency edges (measured literally by degree, betweenness centrality, PageRank, and cross-pillar edge count).
- **"Titan Index" / "0thernes CSS":** Named deterministic weighted formulas over `[1..10]` editorial integer scores and problem age (capped at 300 years), formally bounded and proved monotonic in `lean/MegaAtlasProofs/Scoring.lean`.
- **"Biconnected":** Used in its strict graph-theoretic sense (`nx.is_biconnected(G) == True`: 1 connected component, 0 articulation points, 0 bridge edges).
- **"AutoResearch":** Refers to the deterministic, offline keep/discard evaluation loop (`autoresearch/evaluate.py` + `results.tsv`) optimizing local RAG retrieval metrics under locked gates — not autonomous theorem proving of open conjectures.

===== FILE: REPLICATION.md =====
# Replication Protocol (`REPLICATION.md`)

Any independent researcher can verify all `1,900` records, `5,808` graph edges, `72` Pure Lean 4.35.0 theorems, `100% MRR@5` offline RAG benchmark, dual-framed 9-tool MCP server, FAIR metadata, and byte-exact SHA-256 digests from a clean clone.

## 1. Clean-Clone Verification Steps

```bash
git clone https://github.com/0thernes/unsolved-problems-mega-atlas.git
cd unsolved-problems-mega-atlas
python3 -m pip install -r requirements.txt

# 1. Verify master loader, 48-field JSON Schema, biconnected graph & forensic audit
python3 src/v2_loader.py
python3 scripts/forensic_audit.py

# 2. Run full pytest suite (existing 25 tests + Build Standard property/mutation/integrity tests)
python3 -m pytest -v

# 3. Run cryptographic SHA-256 auditor, AutoResearch oracle & Zenodo dry-run
python3 scripts/audit_atlas.py
python3 autoresearch/evaluate.py --verify-gates
python3 scripts/publish_zenodo.py --dry-run

# 4. Verify all 72 Pure Lean 4.35.0 formal invariant theorems (zero Mathlib, ~15s)
cd lean && lake build && cd ..

# 5. Run Build Standard v1.2.0 repo audit
bash scripts/audit-repo.sh .
```

## 2. Full From-Scratch Regeneration

To regenerate all 15 PNG/SVG charts, all 12 export formats, SQLite+FTS5 DB, `RANKING.md`, FAIR JSON-LD manifests, and `CHECKSUMS.sha256` from the modular Python source under `src/v2_data/`:

```bash
make all        # Linux / macOS / WSL
# or:
.\build.ps1     # Windows PowerShell
```

# 0thernes Research Archive vs. Unsolved Problems Mega-Atlas — Honest Solved-Problem Audit (2026-11-25)

**Audit Date:** 2026-11-25
**Atlas Snapshot Audited:** `outputs/MegaAtlas_Unsolved_Problems_V2.json` (`1,900` problems across `8` Macro-Pillars × `28` Superdomains)
**Archive Snapshot Audited:** `0thernes/0thernes-research-archive/registry/PAPERS.json` (`12` entries, `0TH-2026-001` through `0TH-2026-012`)
**Author:** Alexander Stephen Donahue (`Independent Researcher, Spokane, WA, USA`, ORCID `0009-0006-8168-9648`)

---

## Executive Verdict

- **Grand Mega-Atlas problems retired / completely solved:** **`0 / 1,900`**.
- **Conjecture 7.7 (`0TH-2026-006`, `multinomial-tv-conjecture`, `v2.0.0`):** **`0` matches** among the `61` macro `STAT-*` problems in the Mega-Atlas. Conjecture 7.7 of Banić & Elezović (`arXiv:2610.17046v1`, 2026) is a specialized 2026 paper conjecture in discrete probability/asymptotics that is machine-verified in Lean 4 across 6 kernels, but it is **not** one of the 1,900 macro open problems cataloged in this atlas.
- **Exact partial / special-case / methodological overlaps:** **`7` Mega-Atlas macro nodes** intersect specific sub-results in `0thernes-research-archive`. None of these retire the corresponding grand problem; all `1,900` Mega-Atlas entries remain strictly **OPEN**.

---

## Detailed Overlap Table (Partial / Special-Case Links Only — ZERO Retirements)

| Mega-Atlas ID | Macro Problem Title | Archive Entry(ies) | Exact Verified Scope of Contribution | Why the Grand Problem Remains OPEN |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **`QM-011`** | *Quantum Contextuality, Ontological Models, and Nonlocal Resource Theories* | `0TH-2026-001`..`005`, `009` (`pauli-contextuality-lab`, `v2.7.2`) | Lean 4.35.0 6-kernel proofs of the Hoggar/Kramers spectral floor, Jonah's Conjecture E across all 9 vertex cases for all $N \ge 4$, exact disjoint Mermin degrees $(7^k-5^k)/2$ and $(6^k-4^k)/2$ (Muller & Saniga Sec. 6), KS coordinate-pool minima (31/33/18/29), and finite adaptive-tree sequential contextuality bounds. | Proves sharp specialized theorems on $N$-qubit Pauli geometries and finite sequential games; does not resolve the full general ontological-model classification or universal resource theory of contextuality. |
| **`QC-037`** | *Zauner's SIC-POVM Conjecture* | `0TH-2026-001` (`pauli-contextuality-lab`) | Formalizes the known $d=8$ Hoggar SIC fiducial as a floor-saturating witness of the 3-qubit spectral bound. | Zauner's conjecture requires existence of Weyl–Heisenberg SIC-POVMs in *all* finite dimensions $d \ge 2$; $d=8$ Hoggar lines were already known (Hoggar 1998). |
| **`CS-053`** | *Coded & Byzantine Private Information Retrieval (PIR) Capacity* | `0TH-2026-012` (`coded-pir-mlwe-complexity-lab`) | Explicit coded-PIR / MLWE complexity reductions and finite parameter bounds. | General Byzantine/colluding coded-PIR capacity across all $(N, K, T, B)$ regimes remains open. |
| **`CS-026` / `QC-042`** | *Lattice-Based Cryptography & Module-LWE (MLWE) Worst-to-Average-Case Hardness* | `0TH-2026-012` (`coded-pir-mlwe-complexity-lab`) | Concrete security/complexity bounds and formal analysis of specific MLWE instances. | Worst-case-to-average-case hardness of general MLWE / RLWE for all moduli and error rates remains open. |
| **`CS-005`** | *Time/Space Hierarchy & Catalytic Space Computation* | `0TH-2026-010` (`catalytic-register-frontiers`, DOI `10.5281/ZENODO.24517198`) | Formalized catalytic-register frontier constructions and register-tradeoff bounds. | Major complexity separations (`L` vs `CL` vs `P`, `PSPACE` vs `P`) remain open. |
| **`NEURO-001`** *(and `NEURO-018`..`043`)* | *Neural Correlates of Consciousness & Synaptic Ultrastructure* | `0TH-2026-007`, `0TH-2026-008` (`human-synaptic-bouton-verification`) | Quantitative synaptic bouton verification and mathematical modeling notes. | Fundamental explanatory and empirical problems of consciousness and cortical computation remain open. |

## Epistemic Policy Enforcement

In accordance with `AGENTS.md`, `CLAIMS.md`, and `LIMITATIONS.md`:
1. **No problem in `outputs/MegaAtlas_Unsolved_Problems_V2.json` has been marked solved or retired** based on any 0thernes preprint.
2. Any future retirement of a Mega-Atlas problem requires independent mathematical consensus, statement-fidelity audit, and explicit archival peer verification.
